question_english: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of an Absolute Grading System?
options_english: It provides fixed standards of performance.
A student's grade is not penalized if they are in a highly competitive cohort.
It automatically compensates for an overly difficult examination paper.

explanation_english: Absolute grading measures performance against fixed, pre-determined score thresholds independent of peer performance.
